messages:
maria (Product Designer): quick design review — compact chat controls for the playground. two things: streaming indicator (live token-by-token) layout and stop/regenerate placement; also token counter UX + copy. attaching mockup: https://acme.shs/mock/compact-controls.png

devon (Frontend): saw it. love compactness. question: when user taps Stop — do we keep partial text in editor or freeze at last token? current runtime returns partial output then finalizes. what's product preference?

maria (Product Designer): prefer to keep partial text editable so users can copy/edit then rerun. regen should spawn a fresh run and append to history. we want label to be "Stop" (verb) not "Pause" to avoid confusion.

aaron (Eng): implementation note: stopping mid-stream cancels downstream KV cache write; we can present interim tokens and mark finality with a small badge. will add a `was-interrupted` tag to events.

jia (Accessibility): a11y nits: the streaming region needs `aria-live="polite"` so screen readers receive updates but not be noisy. also keyboard focus order: Stop > Regenerate > Token counter (if clickable). Token counter needs accessible name, e.g., "Tokens used: 42" and not just an icon.

maria (Product Designer): agree. microcopy: change token label from "42T" to "42 tokens" or "≈42 tokens" for readability. show exact on hover. icon-only view should have `aria-label`.

devon (Frontend): small CSS ask: when streaming, highlight new tokens with subtle fade-in, then remove animation after 2s to avoid motion issues. add `prefers-reduced-motion` fallback.

aaron (Eng): can do. for reduced motion, we'll just output instantly and omit animations. also for token counter placement — we prefer right-aligned near send button to avoid length shifts.

maria (Product Designer): ordering consensus: [Stop] [Regenerate] | Token counter — right side. stop button color = orange warn, regenerate = primary. tests: 1) screen reader flow 2) keyboard tab order 3) mobile cramped layout (compact pill menu)

design-bot: uploaded image: compact-controls-v3.png (preview) :eyes:

jia (Accessibility): also check color contrast on orange warn for 3:1 minimum? ideally 4.5:1 for text. if it's icon only, ensure tooltip text meets contrast.

devon (Frontend): plan: I'll prototype in storybook, add aria attributes, simulate interrupted stream. will ping for review when story is up.

maria (Product Designer): thanks — quick copy suggestions for buttons: Stop -> "Stop generation" (tooltip), Regenerate -> "Try again" (smaller). token tooltip -> "Token usage for this message". thumbs?

devon (Frontend): :thumbsup:

aaron (Eng): :rocket:

maria (Product Designer): I'll update mock and add a11y checklist. tagging: @jia for final sign-off before merge.
